# Asset Attribution

## Weapon — Primary Rifle
- **Model:** "Low-poly M4 assault rifle" — UID `fb85c455cf374675a1db7988def2d926`
- **Author:** szaw — https://sketchfab.com/szaw
- **Source:** https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-fb85c455cf374675a1db7988def2d926
- **License:** CC Attribution (CC-BY 4.0)
- **File:** `public/models/weapon.glb` (411,408 bytes, 6081 faces, 8 materials, 0 textures, embedded)
- **Sidecar:** `weapon.glb.attribution.json` (generated by load-sketchfab-threejs skill, preserved)
- **Inspection:** `node scripts/inspect_glb.mjs` reports 8 meshes, 8 materials, no extensions, opaque alpha, double-sided — no normalization required (materials are core PBR, no KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness)
- **Integration:** Loaded via `GLTFLoader` in `src/main.js` with centering/scaling (0.62m maxDim), `castShadow=true`, fallback to procedural rifle if missing
- **Preview sheet:** `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` (contact sheet generated during search)
- **A/B Viewer:** prepared at `/tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab` via `prepare_viewer.py` — serve with `python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/sketchfab-engine-ab` and open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` (Three.js panel shows rendered mesh, stats)

## Map / Textures
- Warehouse floor/walls/crates use procedurally generated CanvasTexture (critic fix for flat materials) with repeat wrapping — no external texture-license dependency. Tiled PBR via `CanvasTexture` + `bumpMap` (6× floor, 4× walls, 1× crates) to emulate scanned albedo/bump at near-zero cost.
